pr_title: Ajax: Run the PATCH test only in IE8 on TestSwarm

issue_context.title: Don't test PATCH requests working in browsers other than IE
issue_context.body: BrowserStack has frequent, recurring problems with PATCH requests not working through their proxy. Since we have no special logic for request type for browsers other than IE, we might as well skip the PATCH test for other browsers if we're on TestSwarm.
comments:
Related: #1938
Fixed in 2524da0.
I forgot to close the issue, doh.
